text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Anatomy of a Release Note That Gets Used
Six parts. A minor fix uses three of them; a feature uses all six and still fits on a phone screen.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 01

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The date, first and unambiguous
Write it out: 26 August 2026. Add a version number
only when your customers actually pin versions.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 02

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: A headline that names the job
"Keep audit logs for as long as your auditor asks",
not "Configurable audit log retention".

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 03

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The eligibility line
Applies to: workspace admins on Business and
Enterprise. Two seconds to self-identify, or nothing.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 04

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: What changed, and what it replaces
Two to four sentences. Name the workaround that
dies, because that is the real competitor.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 05

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The next click
Settings > Compliance > Audit log retention.
An exact path beats available in your settings.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Mono, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: PART 06

text.font-family: Bricolage Grotesque, Segoe UI, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: The reference and the reply route
Docs for the reader who wants depth, and a way
to answer back for the one who has a problem.
Publishing test: can a CSM forward this entry to a named account, unedited, and have it read as a message from a person?
